text:
anya: hey team — first week here. trying to read a service secret for my test app and getting 'permission denied'. ran: `vault kv get secret/data/myapp/test` and it errored. who should I ping to get access?

marco: welcome! :wave: first check: are you in the `okta-redwood-engineers` group? Okta group membership maps to Vault OIDC roles here.

anya: checked Okta — i'm in `redwood-new-hires` but not `okta-redwood-engineers`. how do i request that?

marco: file a request at https://redwood.internal/selfservice -> "Access: Vault" and choose the "engineer - read test secrets" template. include your GitHub handle. devex-bot should auto-create the ticket.

devex-bot: Ticket created #VAULT-4921 for anya — devex will review. Expected SLA 2 business days.

anya: if i need something faster for a demo, is there a temporary fallback?

sarah: we can issue a short-lived Vault token (1 hour) for emergencies — ping @sarah with the ticket link and a justification. we avoid blanket policies. :ok_hand:

marco: FYI the platform uses KV v2 (versioned). to update/rotate keys you `vault kv put secret/myapp api_key=...` and older versions are kept. rotation policy: app API keys rotate every 90 days by default.

anya: thanks. quick q on KMS — do we store raw keys in Vault or wrap with cloud KMS?

sarah: we try to keep long-term root keys in cloud KMS (GCP KMS/AWS KMS) and store only encrypted blobs or wrapped keys in Vault. For most apps we store secrets in Vault and use a KMS key for higher-sensitivity material.

anya: got it. any sample commands i should paste in after access granted?

marco: once you have permission, these are handy:
```
# read secret (kv v2)
vault kv get secret/data/myapp/test

# write / rotate
vault kv put secret/myapp api_key=s3cr3t

# create a 1hr token (devex/ops only)
vault token create -period=1h -policy="temp-read-only"
```

anya: perfect. i'll open the access ticket now and tag you both. thank you! :pray:

marco: ping us in the ticket if you need the 1hr token — we'll approve quickly for demos. also check the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/secrets.md — has screenshots and who-to-ask matrix.

devex-bot: Reminder: Vault MFA enforced for all admin roles.

anya: seen — thanks again everyone :)
